_comment: Single enumeration of the declaration forms this redesign replaced (spec 0183 R12). Both scripts/lib/extension-manifest.sh (ext_assert_current_shape, the fail-closed reader) and scripts/migrate-extension.sh (the converter) read this file; neither carries its own list. A form absent here is not failed as old shape; a form present here is failed by every reader (spec 0183 R13).
